name: Lake Harriet
description: A full loop around the lake, with the bandshell lawn on the north shore and a wide path the whole way.

name: Bde Maka Ska
description: The longest lake loop in the Chain of Lakes, with separate spaces for people walking and people riding.

name: Lake of the Isles
description: A quieter loop with two islands, footbridges, and a connection north toward Cedar Lake.

name: Cedar Lake
description: A shorter lake loop on the west side, linked to the Isles path and the Cedar Lake Trail.

name: Brownie Lake
description: A small loop at the north end of Cedar Lake, useful when you only have time for a short walk.

name: Lake Nokomis
description: A south-side lake loop with a beach, a community center, and a path that stays close to the water.

name: Lake Hiawatha
description: A compact loop beside the golf course, easy to pair with a longer ride on Minnehaha Creek.

name: Minnehaha Park
description: Paths around the falls and down the glen toward the Mississippi, with stairs and a gentler upper route.

name: Minnehaha Creek
description: A creek path from Lake Nokomis toward the falls, shaded in places and mostly flat.

name: Stone Arch Bridge
description: A short river crossing on a former railroad bridge, with the downtown skyline on one side.

name: West River Parkway
description: A parkway path along the west bank of the Mississippi, from the Stone Arch Bridge toward the falls.

name: East River Flats
description: A riverside path below the University of Minnesota, with a view back toward downtown.

name: Midtown Greenway
description: A former rail line through south Minneapolis, built for bikes and kept separate from car traffic.

name: Theodore Wirth
description: Wooded park paths around Wirth Lake, with more hills than the chain-of-lakes loops.

name: Victory Memorial Parkway
description: A tree-lined parkway in north Minneapolis, with a long straight path and few street crossings.

name: Powderhorn Lake
description: A neighborhood loop around the lake in Powderhorn Park, flat and easy to reach on foot.

name: Loring Park
description: A short downtown park loop around the pond, close to the sculpture garden.

name: Nicollet Island
description: A small island walk in the Mississippi, connected to downtown by the Hennepin Avenue bridge.
